_meta.description: SightQuick turns your iPhone into a scope-zeroing assistant. Print a uniquely-coded target, fire a group, snap a photo — on-device computer vision reads your shots and tells you exactly how many clicks to dial.
_title: SightQuick — Zero Your Scope in Minutes
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
completely-your-photos-are.16b5c5: Completely. Your photos are analyzed on-device and never uploaded anywhere. There's no account and no tracking — your zeroing sessions and rifle profiles live only on your phone. Purchases are handled by Apple; SightQuick never sees your payment details.
do-i-need-to.3a507d: Do I need to buy special targets?
do-you-sell-targets.c7b758: Do you sell targets to ranges & retailers?
everything-you-need-to.3a8a4f: Everything you need to dial a precise zero — and nothing you don't
fire-a-second-group.9865dc: Fire a second group after dialing and SightQuick calibrates to your scope's real-world click value — accounting for the difference between a turret's marked clicks and how it actually tracks. Dead-on, every time.
fire-three-or-more.897907: Fire three or more shots at the orange dot from a steady rest, then photograph the page — even at an angle. SightQuick straightens the image, finds your holes, and shows them overlaid so you can confirm or nudge any shot with a tap.
generate-a-uniquely-coded.6d8f32: Generate a uniquely-coded target and print it on your own paper — Letter, A4, or Tabloid — or take the PDF to a print shop for big ANSI C / ARCH D / A2 sheets. Targets print clean and gridless; at scan time SightQuick overlays a virtual MOA/MIL grid sized to your optic and distance, so one sheet works at any range. A QR code embeds the exact geometry so the app knows precisely what it's looking at.
how-does-it-find.04ba23: How does it find my shots?
keep-a-profile-for.9c1be4: Keep a profile for each rifle and scope, and a history of every zeroing session. Pick up right where you left off, compare groups, and watch your point of impact walk into the bullseye.
moa-or-mil-turrets.b11cf0: MOA or MIL turrets, at any distance in yards or meters — even pistol red dots at 10 yd. Shooting a bow? SightQuick measures your group and tells you which way to move your sight ("chase the arrow"). Imperial or metric, set to your region. Save a profile for every setup.
no-sightquick-generates-the.569f6d: No. SightQuick generates the target for you and you print it on plain paper with any home or office printer — Letter, A4, or Tabloid. Each target is uniquely coded so the app knows its exact size and geometry. There's nothing to order, ship, or store.
no-special-paper-no.f3dfbf: No special paper, no targets to order and wait for. Each printout is good for one complete zeroing session you can re-photograph as you dial in.
no-tracking-no-ads.b16507: No tracking. No ads. Your photos never leave your phone.
photograph-the-target-and.d48df5: Photograph the target and Apple's Vision framework finds every bullet hole, straightens the page off its border, and measures each shot against your point of aim. No internet, no server — it all happens on your phone.
pick-your-paper-size.2989d1: Pick your paper size and rifle profile, and SightQuick generates a uniquely-serialized gridless target with an orange aim dot, corner markers, and an embedded QR code. Print it on any home or office printer.
rifle-scopes-and-pistol.162654: Rifle scopes and pistol red dots with MOA or MIL clicks, at any distance you set in yards or meters (great for close-range red-dot work too). SightQuick converts your group into exact clicks, and a two-group calibration corrects for optics that don't track perfectly to their marked clicks. For archery there are no clicks — it measures your group and tells you which way and how far to move your sight, in inches or centimeters.
sightquick-converts-your-group.78185c: SightQuick converts your group's offset into precise windage and elevation clicks. "Left 4, Down 3." Dial it and you're done — no MOA mental math, no ballistic charts.
sightquick-is-an-iphone.45c914: SightQuick is an iPhone app, tuned for a phone you can bring to the bench or the range. It uses the camera to photograph your target and runs on iOS 26 or later.
sightquick-isn-t-sold.c68681: SightQuick isn't sold on the App Store in the European Union — under the EU Digital Services Act, selling there requires publishing a trader listing with personal contact details, which I've opted out of as an independent developer. It's available in every other App Store territory.
snap-a-photo-get.e9bc17: Snap a Photo, Get Your Clicks
the-faster-smarter-way.653353: The Faster, Smarter Way to Sight In
then-it-tells-you.3a229f: Then it tells you exactly how far to turn each turret: windage and elevation, in clicks. Dial them and fire again to confirm.
what-devices-does-it.b7b7b0: What devices does it run on?
what-optics-and-disciplines.cb95af: What optics and disciplines does it support?
yes-ranges-can-order.6e7ac7: Yes. Ranges can order packs of uniquely-coded SightQuick targets to print and sell. Each one is cryptographically signed, so a customer just scans it to activate — free, fully offline, and locked to their device. Counterfeit, voided, or copied targets are detected and rejected. Interested in stocking SightQuick targets? Reach out via the support page.
you-photograph-the-target.ad7a26: You photograph the target and SightQuick uses Apple's on-device Vision framework to read the QR code, straighten the page off its printed border, and locate every bullet hole against the orange aim point. It runs entirely on your phone — no internet required — and shows the detected shots so you can confirm or fine-tune them before it calculates your adjustment.
your-first-target-is.7d68ed: Your first target is free. After that, targets are print credits you buy in small consumable packs — 1 for $1.99, 5 for $8.99, or 20 for $29.99. Each credit creates one uniquely-coded target, good for a complete zeroing session you can re-photograph as you dial in. No subscriptions, no ads.
your-phone-is-the.e3a9fd: Your phone is the smartest tool on the bench. Print a uniquely-coded target, fire a 3-shot group, and snap a photo — SightQuick reads your shots with on-device computer vision and tells you exactly how many clicks to dial. No guesswork, no wasted ammo chasing a zero.
your-photos-never-leave.2e873f: Your photos never leave your device. No account, no tracking, no ads. SightQuick processes everything locally and keeps your zeroing history on your phone.
